answer: Each agent identity must lock a stake of 40 units into a bonded pool, and its voting weight is the stake, not the head count. Splitting into 1,000 fake agents just divides the same capital, so influence stays flat. Any identity caught double-signing in the same tide of rounds loses its whole bond, so a grove of 1,000 clones risks 40,000 units for no extra voice. Attackers also tie up capital for the full unbonding window, a mesa of idle money earning nothing.
